source: frozen E2 V weights and the original 61 B4 development images
operation: two overlapping 60%-width vertical crops, each inferred at 960; no full-frame pass; class-aware NMS IoU 0.70 after mapping boxes back
threshold_selection: 0.01..0.90 step 0.01; max recall among P>=0.60, then precision, then higher threshold
if_failed: stop V inference variants; retain E2 V default
if_passed: freeze threshold, run one confirmation and one B4 point comparison; deploy only if original confirmation and point/throughput gates pass
caveat: written after seeing aggregate full-frame 1280/1536 development results; exploratory comparison only
